\section{Full simulation results}\label{sec:sims-supp}

This section gives every setting of designs S1 and S2 (Section~\ref{sec:sims}) for every measure of
Section~\ref{sec:sims-metrics}. Entries are averages over the $100$ data sets of a setting, except exact recovery,
which is a count out of $100$. In design S2 the ASI column (marked $\dagger$) is interim: it averages the first $25$
data sets of each setting, the only ones for which ASI had finished when this draft was built, so its exact-recovery
counts are out of $25$. The other five methods use all $100$ data sets; on the first $25$ their selected models are
identical to those used in Section~\ref{sec:sims}.
